page_title: UDI 0-1 JUV | Udinese v Juventus 14/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+3' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
90+2' Luciano Spalletti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jonathan David (Juventus) replacing Andrea Cambiaso.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Filip Kostic (Juventus) is coming onto the pitch as Kenan Yildiz cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.

89' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Fabio Miretti (Juventus), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
88' Maurizio Mariani shows a yellow card to Branimir Mlacic (Udinese), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
85' The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
84' Kosta Runjaic has decided to substitute Arthur Atta and he is replaced by Idrissa Gueye (Udinese).
83' Flag up against Kenan Yildiz (Juventus). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
82' Juventus keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.
80' Weston McKennie (Juventus) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
79' Today's match ends for Jeremie Boga who will be replaced by Federico Gatti (Juventus).
78' Here is a change. Francisco Conceicao is going off and Luciano Spalletti gives the last tactical orders to Fabio Miretti (Juventus).
76' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Oier Zarraga will be replaced by Branimir Mlacic (Udinese).
76' Substitution. Jesper Karlstrom makes way for Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese).
75' Neat passing move from Juventus in order to create new attacking opportunities.
74' The goal by Juventus won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
72' Wait! Referee Maurizio Mariani has indicated he is going to review the Juventus goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
70' Goal! A great through ball by Kenan Yildiz sets up Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball low into the middle of the goal. 0:2.
67' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp is replaced by Lennon Miller (Udinese).
67' The substitution has been made. Juan Arizala (Udinese) has replaced Hassane Kamara.
65' The linesman makes the right call and Juventus will have a corner.
64' Juventus take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
64' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.

62' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Maduka Okoye, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
62' Juventus hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
60' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
59' Nice passing game by Juventus. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
57' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) attempts to find Jeremie Boga, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
56' Handball! A player from Udinese handled the ball. Juventus will take a free kick.
53' The total number of attempts is 6:14.
51' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal.
50' Udinese are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
49' Problems for Luciano Spalletti as Khephren Thuram (Juventus) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Teun Koopmeiners replaces him.
48' Udinese hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
44' Arthur Atta (Udinese) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
43' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).
42' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

41' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Jeremie Boga (Juventus) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Maduka Okoye pulls off a brilliant save.

41' Great chance! Arthur Atta (Udinese) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
38' 0 - 1 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Kenan Yildiz finds Jeremie Boga (Juventus) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.

36' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
36' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot low towards the middle of the net that is easily dealt with by Maduka Okoye.
34' The resulting corner from Jeremie Boga (Juventus) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
32' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) was quite harsh and Maurizio Mariani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
30' Udinese enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
28' Weston McKennie (Juventus) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
28' Nice passing game by Juventus. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
26' Arthur Atta (Udinese) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the middle of the goal is smartly dealt with by Mattia Perin.
23' Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul after Oier Zarraga (Udinese) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
21' The ratio of the ball possession is 37:63.
18' The referee points to the corner flag and Juventus will take a corner.
17' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
16' The Udinese players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
14' Good work from Juventus as they win a corner.
14' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Maduka Okoye reacts superbly to deny him.
13' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
10' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is penalised for a foul. Maurizio Mariani had a clear view and blows his whistle.
10' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
9' Juventus seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
8' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
5' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Keinan Davis (Udinese) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
3' The Juventus players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Juventus will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Maurizio Mariani.
